EA_POINT_DENSITY_50CM
A 50 cm DSM survey requires four points per square metre on average.
EA_POINT_DENSITY_25CM
A 25 cm DSM survey requires sixteen points per square metre on average.
EA_POINT_DENSITY_DSM_ONLY
Published point-density figures refer to the DSM rather than necessarily to the DTM.
EA_POINT_CLOUD_IRREGULAR
A LiDAR point cloud is not a regular grid.
EA_PROJECTION_BNG
Environment Agency LiDAR data is supplied in OSGB36 British National Grid.
EA_VERTICAL_DATUM_AODN
Environment Agency LiDAR elevations are recorded above Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
EA_POST2016_OSGM15
Surveys after 26 August 2016 use the OSGM15 geoid model.
OS_T50_TWO_PRODUCTS_CONTEXT
OS Terrain 5 and OS Terrain 50 are Ordnance Survey digital terrain products.
OS_T50_BARE_EARTH
OS Terrain 50 primarily represents the bare-earth ground surface with buildings and trees removed.
OS_T50_LOWER_RESOLUTION
OS Terrain 50 is the lower-resolution product intended for landscape analysis over large areas.
OS_T50_OPEN_DATA
OS Terrain 50 is an Open Data product.
OS_T50_GRID_AND_CONTOUR
OS Terrain 50 is published as both grid data and contour data.
OS_T50_SAME_SOURCE
The grid and contour products are created from the same source data.
OS_T50_10KM_TILES
Tiled OS Terrain 50 products use 10 km by 10 km tiles.
OS_T50_SW_REFERENCE
A tile is identified by the National Grid reference of its south-west corner.
OS_T50_GRID_50M_POST
The grid product uses regularly spaced height points at 50 m intervals.
OS_T50_CONTOUR_10M
The contour product contains standard contour polylines at 10 m vertical intervals.
OS_VECTOR_NATIONAL_MBTILES
OS Terrain 50 contour vector tiles are supplied nationally in one MBTiles file.
OS_VECTOR_LIGHTWEIGHT
The vector tiles are designed as a lightweight tile set.
OS_VECTOR_FAST_RENDER
The vector tiles are intended to render efficiently and quickly.
OS_VECTOR_SEAMLESS_ZOOM
The vector-tile supply supports seamless zooming.
OS_VECTOR_EPSG3857
OS Terrain 50 vector tiles use Web Mercator, EPSG:3857.
OS_VECTOR_CONTOUR_LAYER
The vector-tile schema contains a contour_line layer.
OS_VECTOR_SPOT_LAYER
The vector-tile schema contains a spot_height layer.
OS_VECTOR_WATER_LAYER
The vector-tile schema contains a land_water_boundary layer.
OS_VECTOR_ATTRIBUTES_Z9_14
Layer identifiers and height attributes are mapped at zoom levels 9 through 14.
OS_VECTOR_NOT_Z0_8
The documented contour, spot-height and water-boundary attributes are not mapped at zoom levels 0 through 8.
OS_SUPPLY_GPKG_NATIONAL
GeoPackage format is supplied as a single national flat file.
OS_SUPPLY_VECTOR_NATIONAL
Vector-tile format is supplied as a single national flat file.
OS_SUPPLY_TILED_ZIP
Grid and tiled contour data are supplied in compressed folders by geographic tile.
OS_SUPPLY_ANNUAL_FULL_TILE
The product is maintained through annual full-tile resupply.
OS_SUPPLY_GB_COVERAGE
OS Terrain 50 provides full national coverage of Great Britain.
OS_SUPPLY_MASTERMAP_SOURCE
The data is derived from the same source programme used to update OS MasterMap Topography Layer.
OS_SUPPLY_GRID_SIZE_157MB
A full national compressed supply of OS Terrain 50 grid tiles is approximately 157 MB.
OS_SUPPLY_JULY
OS Terrain 50 is supplied annually in July.
OS_REFRESH_ANNUAL
The OS product refresh table lists OS Terrain 50 as an annual product.
OS_REFRESH_MONTH_JULY
The OS product refresh table lists July as the publication month for OS Terrain 50.
